n-privacy.title: Privacy coins
n-privacy.summary: Coins whose metadata or official posts describe on-chain privacy: ZERO (a privacy token on Robinhood Chain), DarkSwap (DARK; private swaps routed through NEAR Intents toward ZEC), Nullmask (MASK; ZK privacy protocol, metadata says by core ZEC contributors), OMNI (private payments and shielded ZEC) and ZkProof (ZKD; private balances on Robinhood Chain). Public posts around Zcash's rally describe privacy as a narrative; the coins' claims are not verified and no affiliation among them was checked. Measured: five coins across all their pools.

n-holder-rewards.title: Holder rewards in the paired asset
n-holder-rewards.summary: Coins whose metadata says holders earn another asset: ZCAT (ZEC), PUMPE (PEPE reflections), MASKCAT (MASK, which pays ZEC), MMBTC (WBTC), SEC (XRP) and STUPIDINU (paired with USELESS rewards). StonkFun's official account posted on 2026-09-29 that its upgraded rewards pipeline is live for legacy coins including ZCAT. Payouts are claims from the coins and the platform and are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools; the paired assets are not counted.

summaries.n-ai-agents: Robinhood Chain coins whose metadata describes AI agents: ZZZ (swarm coordination), PARLEY (social layer), Liege Agents (agent work escrow), Agent Wormhole (agentic finance security), Priors Agents (credit for ERC-8004 agents), Harmonic Agent, Otis Sherwood (an agent running a business), TANK (agents build a game), CRADLE (a launchpad where each token is paired with an AI agent, per its metadata), Moonlet (little AI agents, built on Orbio) and Orbiobook (a social platform for Orbio agents). Public posts around the HOOD Summit and ERC-8004 agent registries describe the theme; the coins' claims are not verified and no affiliation among them was checked. Measured: eleven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence". Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term, and its daily volume jumped from $9M to $67M. New coins followed: another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Gooner Intelligence (SGI), si.gov and others. None is affiliated with the announcement. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
